hard_rules: a compiled binary is not a release and source build evidence signature bundle channel installation and support are independent gates
the baseline public bundle contains one wow executable and excludes internal release tooling unless an explicit administrative profile permits it
the first support target intent is Windows x86-64 MSVC but it is not advertised until the exact complete platform matrix passes
release source identity is the exact complete tree and not a tag branch filename working tree or version string
Cargo lockfile Rust toolchain target features dependencies build scripts environment deterministic path time and executor profiles are exact inputs
build service uses a narrow typed executor and exposes no arbitrary shell command environment callback SQL HTTP or provider API
normal build consumes already verified materialized inputs and does not silently access the network
at least two independent unsigned builds are required for a reproducibility claim
platform signing happens after unsigned digest freeze and never redefines unsigned build identity
SBOM provenance license notices checksums schemas compatibility registry tests benchmarks signatures and verification instructions are first class immutable artifacts
Reference Packs core packs provider adapters and other data artifacts retain independent identity signature compatibility and update lifecycles
an offline data bundle is explicit and cannot copy floating current data
release bundle paths members modes archive metadata and limits are deterministic and reject traversal links devices collisions and bombs
portable release update revocation and retirement signatures use exact domain separated digests and nonsecret trust references
private signing code-signing distribution CI package-manager and deployment material never enters repository public config fixtures logs bundles or canonical results
channel prepare publish object upload readback manifest publication and channel CAS are separate exact effects
channel stable latest newest tag age downloads and absence of complaints never replace release candidate gates
GitHub Releases is an optional provider adapter and repository CI tag or account identity is not release authorization or trust
baseline performs no startup or hidden update check download install telemetry crash upload or remote configuration
update discovery download verification staging backup migration activation self-check LKR cleanup and rollback are separate exact states
the running Windows executable is replaced only through an exact verified helper or owner strategy and never overwrites itself ad hoc
store and configuration migration use registered owner operations backups crash recovery and explicit rollback compatibility and never raw SQL or scripts
current installation and channel records update through exact expected current compare and swap
last known runnable is explicitly qualified and never inferred as previous newest or directory position
rollback creates new immutable records and never rewrites or relabels failed release history
revocation retirement and incident containment remain distinct signed authorized records
support claims are limited to the exact tested OS architecture protocol store schema data pack WoW profile feature client and resource matrix
patch sensitive WoW support is revalidated through the current KB exact pinned Blizzard reference inputs and required runtime evidence
every effect registers OperationId plus CanonicalRequestDigest and OutcomeUnknown blocks blind build sign upload install update rollback revoke or retire repetition
no public success before required readback verification retention audit and reverse order close
applications and release tools depend on wow-service only and invoke one service operation per command
missing implementation source dependency toolchain builder signing distribution installer platform client benchmark or checksum evidence is blocked or NotEvaluated never pass
no CI workflow is added before real frozen commands exist and an explicit owner authorizes it
